review.summary: 12,913-triangle reduced model preserves the reviewed face, cap seams, workwear pockets, glove silhouettes and boots. Front, rear-oblique and neutral views compared against source-stage renders. Fresh FBX and GLB imports pass.

Front and both oblique renders preserve teal cap/coveralls, silver zipper, gray hair, older facial lines, white gloves and dark boots. Face features and clothing borders remain correctly positioned with no major texture bleed.

Front and both oblique clay views match the cleaner reference: brimmed cap, older face, coverall zip and pockets, cuffs, separate gloves and sturdy boots. No major fused limb or missing body part; proportions allow the planned skeleton fit.
